question: Should this issue remain the canonical dashboard-widget task after the modular-dashboard foundation and per-session activity contract land, or should it be folded into another canonical item?
rationale: The request is coherent and aligned with the roadmap, but current main lacks both the widget host and the durable activity/attention contract, so implementation sequencing and ownership need maintainer direction.

options.title: Keep As Staged Widget Task
options.body: Keep this issue open as the presentation-layer task, sequenced after the Wave 1 dashboard PRs and https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/39127 are settled.

options.title: Fold Into Activity Contract
options.body: Let https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/39127 own the remaining backend semantics, then reopen or split a narrower widget task after that API exists.

options.title: Defer To External Plugin
options.body: If bundled dashboard widgets are not desired, defer this to an external plugin or ClawHub package once the widget SDK is public.

recommendation.title: Keep As Staged Widget Task
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open as the presentation-layer task, sequenced after the Wave 1 dashboard PRs and https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/39127 are settled.

likelyOwner.reason: The activity-state API dependency is assigned to vincentkoc, making that the most concrete owner signal for the product contract this widget would consume.
